Hi,
If I'm not mistaken, it should be scale not scales when you specify which. (scale =“free_y“)


-----Anvar Suyundikov <anvar.su...@gmail.com> wrote: -----

=======================
To: ggp...@googlegroups.com
From: Anvar Suyundikov <anvar.su...@gmail.com>
Date: 07/23/2012 09:32PM
Subject: How to change manually the scales of grids in ggplot2
=======================
Hi,
I am trying to change scales of grids using scales = "free_y" or scales =
"free_x".
But they don't work properly. How can I fix it?

Here is what I doing:

ggplot(bird3, aes(BiologicalOrder)) +
geom_point(stat="bin", size = 3, aes(shape = Condition, position =
"stack")) +
coord_flip()+ scale_shape(solid = FALSE) +
facet_grid(Condition ~ Oiling, scales = "free_x")

Thanks,
Anvar

messages.subject: Re: How to change manually the scales of grids in ggplot2
parts:
It's the coord_flip() - trying to flip coordinates in concert with
facet_grid() often does not work as one expects. You might have better
luck trying to recode the plot call to avoid the coord_flip(), in
which case the scales = argument may have a better chance of working.
This shouldn't be difficult because you're using geom_point() rather
than, say, geom_bar(). BTW, you didn't define cyl2 in your example:

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl2' not found

Dennis
